display.purpose: Landing hero only; mobile uses clamp(38px,8.5vw,62px) and line-height 1.12.

body.purpose: Landing body; self-hosted Manrope variable font, 200–800, OFL.

shadows.name: receipt-paper
shadows.purpose: Only the rotated receipt illustration; ordinary reading surfaces are flat.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Action background/lift, sample-chip background and scene-control background changes.

motion.name: device-idle-float
motion.purpose: Small opposing phone/dashboard vertical float in scene units; stops for pause, reduced motion, offscreen and hidden tab.

motion.name: device-expansion-damping
motion.purpose: Device separation and reassembly; immediately reaches target when paused.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Removes landing CSS animation/transition and starts the 3D scene paused; explicit play can opt into motion.

components.name: Primary account action
components.description: Forest action on the warm landing canvas.
components.html: <button type="button" class="ds-button">Mulai sekarang — gratis<svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M5 12h14m-6-6 6 6-6 6"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-button { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:26px; min-height:54px; padding:14px 22px; border:0; border-radius:8px; background:#173d32; color:#f6f5ee; font-family:Manrope,sans-serif; font-size:13px; font-weight:700; cursor:pointer; transition:background 180ms,transform 180ms; } .ds-button:hover { background:#2e5641; transform:translateY(-2px); } .ds-button:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #477044; outline-offset:5px; } @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-button { transition:none; } }

components.name: Closing account action
components.description: Lime action on the dark closing band.
components.css: .ds-button { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:26px; min-height:54px; padding:14px 22px; border:0; border-radius:8px; background:#173d32; color:#f6f5ee; font-family:Manrope,sans-serif; font-size:13px; font-weight:700; cursor:pointer; transition:background 180ms,transform 180ms; } .ds-button:hover { background:#2e5641; transform:translateY(-2px); } .ds-button:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #477044; outline-offset:5px; } @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-button { transition:none; } } .ds-closing { background:#173d32; padding:24px; } .ds-lime { background:#d2ee8b; color:#173d32; } .ds-lime:hover { background:#e0f3b7; }

components.name: Sample selectors
components.description: Pressed and unpressed examples of the landing transaction selector.
components.css: .ds-samples { display:flex; gap:8px; background:#d8e8ce; padding:20px; } .ds-chip { min-height:44px; padding:8px 14px; border-radius:6px; font-family:Manrope,sans-serif; font-size:11px; font-weight:600; color:#355740; border:1px solid #9eb598; background:transparent; cursor:pointer; transition:background 180ms; } .ds-chip[aria-pressed="true"] { background:#173d32; border-color:#173d32; color:#f6f5ee; } .ds-chip:hover:not([aria-pressed="true"]) { background:#c2d8b8; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #477044; outline-offset:5px; } @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-chip { transition:none; } }

narrative.overview: Warm paper, forest ink and a pale mint device stage make everyday finance approachable and orderly. Large Manrope headings and open spacing establish an editorial rhythm; ledger rules organize detail. Scope: public landing only. Dashboard, login and the shared PWA installation modal keep their incumbent dark visual system.
keyCharacteristics: Oversized balanced type and open editorial spacing
Flat ledger reading surfaces and restrained rounded controls
Procedural devices paired with a readable HTML sample result
One slow idle movement with pause and reduced-motion support

rules.name: The Scoped Palette Rule
rules.body: Keep the landing palette local; do not propagate it into dashboard or authentication styles.

rules.name: The Flat Reading Surface Rule
rules.body: Text sections and ledger rows remain flat. Physical depth belongs to product illustrations.

dos: Do preserve the original Fisc.io logo and self-hosted Manrope.
Do preserve keyboard focus, 44px targets and motion controls.
Do retain readable HTML sample data outside the canvas.
donts: Don't theme dashboard, login or the shared dark PWA modal with landing tokens.
Don't add shadows to ordinary reading surfaces.
Don't use private account data or imply live user screenshots in the sample.
